evals.expected_output: [positive fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S3 正向例子2] A schema-1.1.0 fraction capability_concept_graph organized around a focus question, with assessable learning units, reusable atomic nodes, many-to-many mappings, hard/soft prerequisites from unit whole to equivalent fractions and operations, and a passing G3 route to S4.
expectations: The graph is organized around a focus question and uses multiple representations (e.g. number line, area model) rather than listing fraction rules as a chapter sequence.
The capability outline contains assessable learning_units, and narrow scope may omit a synthetic middle level only with an explicit rationale and a valid target-capability parent.
Every learning unit has a core node mapping; reusable concepts such as unit whole or number-line representation keep one canonical node ID across mappings.
Containment and readable outline order are not used as a substitute for hard/soft prerequisite edges.
The directed prerequisite edges form an acyclic structure and the hard path from unit whole to equivalent fractions and common denominators contains no cycle.
Every hard prerequisite edge has an explicit rationale grounded in the fraction concept structure.
Every target capability (comparing, explaining equivalence, applying to context problems) traces to the nodes that support it.

Every key node has an observable capability statement, a plausible misconception (e.g. larger numerator and denominator imply a larger fraction), and an assessment item spanning explanation, application or transfer.
Traceability connects nodes to S1 capabilities and S2 audited evidence, and G3 routes deterministically to S4 when all invariants hold.
